items.title: Brock Bowers: Practicing again Friday
items.text:
Bowers (ankle) was present for Friday's practice, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

items.title: Isaiah Likely: Should be OK for Week 11
items.text:
Head coach John Harbaugh said Friday that Likely is tending to a "minor thing" but should be good to play Sunday against the Jaguars, Jordan Raanan of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Anthony Richardson: New starting QB in Indy
items.text:
Head coach Shane Steichen announced Friday that Richardson will be the Colts' starting quarterback moving forward after the team waived Daniel Jones.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dalton Kincaid: Gets doubtful tag
items.text:
Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Matt Parrino reports.

items.title: Daniel Jones: Being let go by Indianapolis
items.text:
Jones will be waived by the Colts, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
